programme.desc: A half-caste boy-soldier and a Maori girl-prophet strike up an unlikely friendship in the midst of the climactic battle of the New Zealand.

programme.title: Out Of Season
programme.desc: Mathieu, a famous actor, and Alice, a piano teacher, reunite after 15 years apart at a spa, revisiting past love and confronting the passage of time and lingering emotions.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: Margaret Pomeranz and David Stratton report from Sydney and Melbourne Film Festivals with interviews including Armand Assante, Kenneth Anger, John Akomfrah and filmmakers of Black Harvest.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: The Bridge On The River Kwai
programme.desc: British POWs are ordered by their Japanese captors to construct a bridge of strategic importance and are happy to sabotage and delay the progress until their commanding officers orders them to continue the work unhindered to its completion.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: Johnny Rambo is a Vietnam vet who won many military honours. Arrested in a small town for loitering, he escapes custody and a manhunt is launched- but Rambo knows how to evade traps.

programme.title: Letters From Iwo Jima
programme.desc: As the Americans approach, the Japanese defenders dig deep into the volcanic earth of Iwo Jima. Some want to be heroes, others just want to see their wives. Directed by Clint Eastwood, starring Ken Watanabe, Kazunari Ninomiya, Tsuyoshi Ihara.

programme.title: Letters From Iwo Jima
programme.desc: As the Americans approach, the Japanese defenders dig deep into the volcanic earth of Iwo Jima. Some want to be heroes, others just want to see their wives. Directed by Clint Eastwood, starring Ken Watanabe, Kazunari Ninomiya, Tsuyoshi Ihara.

programme.title: The First Day Of My Life
programme.desc: In the exact moment they’re hitting rock bottom, a man, two women and a boy meet a mysterious man capable of gifting them a week of time where they’ll discover how the world would be without them. Will they find the strength to start over and fall in love with life again?

programme.title: Like Water For Chocolate
programme.desc: In a Mexican border town around 1910, Tita falls passionately in love with Pedro, but her controlling mother forbids her from marrying him. When Pedro marries her sister, Tita throws herself into her cooking and discovers she can transfer her emotions through the food she prepares, infecting all who eat it with her intense heartbreak. Directed by Alsonso Arau and stars Lumi Cavazos and Pedro Muzquiz.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: Whisky Galore
programme.desc: During World War II, the tiny Scottish island of Todday runs out of whisky. When the freighter S.S. Cabinet Minister runs aground nearby during a heavy fog, the islanders are delighted to learn that its cargo consists of 50,000 cases of whisky. But when an officious English captain demands the return of the liquor, the islanders rebel. Stars Eddie Izzard, Gregor Fisher and Naomi Battrick.

programme.title: The Skin Of Others
programme.desc: The Skin of Others is a story of modern Australia - its violent past and its future potential - told through the extraordinary life of Aboriginal World War One soldier Douglas Grant (c.1885-1951). Featuring acclaimed Indigenous actor Balang Tom E. Lewis in his final performance (as Douglas Grant) and guest appearances from Max Cullen and Archie Roach, this film movingly interweaves the lives of Grant and Lewis: two truly remarkable men.

programme.title: What We Do In the Shadows
programme.desc: Viago, Deacon, and Vladislav are vampires who find that modern life has them struggling with the mundane - like paying rent, keeping up with the daily chores, trying to get into nightclubs, and overcoming flatmate conflicts. Directed by and starring Jemaine Clement and Taika Waititi. Also stars Cori Gonzalez-Macuer and Karen O'Leary.

programme.title: The Lighthorsemen
programme.desc: Four men of the Australian Light Horse Regiment are thrust into a cavalry charge when the British campaign in Palestine becomes stalemated in 1917. In a desperate attempt, 800 young Australian horsemen set off against gunfire and insurmountable odds to save the attacking British soldiers. Stars Peter Phelps, Nick Waters and Sigrid Thorton.

programme.title: Finding Altamira
programme.desc: In 1879, a Spanish archaeologist and his eight-year-old daughter cause worldwide controversy when they discover cave paintings that are 10,000 years old. The discovery will put the family at odds with the religious and scientific leaders of the day. Directed by Hugh Hudson and stars Antonio Banderas, Clement Sibony and Golshifteh Farahani.

programme.title: The Eagle Huntress
programme.desc: This spell-binding documentary follows Aisholpan, a 13-year-old nomadic Mongolian girl who is fighting to become the first female eagle hunter in twelve generations of her Kazakh family. Through breathtaking aerial cinematography and intimate verite footage, the film captures her personal journey while also addressing universal themes like female empowerment, the natural world, coming of age and the onset of modernity.

programme.title: What We Did On Our Holiday
programme.desc: Doug and Abi take their kids on a family holiday. Surrounded by relatives, the kids innocently reveal the ins and outs of their family life and many intimate details about their parents. It's soon clear that when it comes to keeping a big secret under wraps from the rest of the family, their children are their biggest liability. Stars David Tennant and Rosamund Pike.

programme.title: U-96, The True Story Of Das Boot
programme.desc: The international success of the film Das Boot made the U-96 the most famous of all Hitler's submarines and the best-known movie submarine. But the true story of this extraordinary submarine and its equally exceptional crew goes far beyond fiction.

programme.title: The Free State Of Jones
programme.desc: After serving as a medic in the Civil War, Newton Knight returns home to Mississippi to safeguard his family. Branded as an outlaw deserter, he leads a militia of fellow deserters, runaway slaves, and women in an uprising against the corrupt local Confederate government. Directed by Gary Ross and stars Matthew McConaughey, Gugu Mbatha-Raw and Mahershala Ali.

programme.title: Flags Of Our Fathers
programme.desc: Filmmaking legends Spielberg and Eastwood collaborate on a gripping portrayal of the WWII battle for Iwo Jima, focusing on the iconic flag-raising image and the tragic loss of life on both sides.

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Bean curd, aka tofu, is the most common meat-sub for the veg-heads out there. But there's nothing common about Mary's new takes on tofu.

programme.title: Eva Pau's Asian Christmas
programme.desc: For her Festive Feast, Eva is serving up a succulent Five Spice Roast Duck with next-level. Spicy Hasselback Roast Potatoes and Eva's Chilli Garlic Sprouts will convert even the biggest sprout-avoider.

programme.title: Mary Berry Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Mary Berry's joined by famous friends who need culinary help-Mel Giedroyc, Jordan North, Anton Du Beke, Lorraine Kelly, AJ Odudu & Michael Ball-to show them how easy cooking can be.

programme.title: Batch From Scratch: Cooking For Less
programme.desc: Joe Swash and Suzanne Mulholland visit Port Talbot to help a family swap their unhealthy 'beige buffet' for fresh, home-cooked meals and reignite dad Adam's lost love for cooking.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Food Tastes Better With Sand Between Your Toes
programme.desc: In the Caribbean paradise of St. Martin, Tony eats a healthy Rastafarian meal with a freedom fighter, helps prepare grub for a food caravan, and discovers foodstuffs not available in America.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: In New Orleans, Louisiana, Tony catches a Bayou alligator, cools off with a world-famous snow cone and eats jambalaya with a dancing chef.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: Tennis player Priscilla Hon and YouTuber Ann Reardon join Adam to make the case for salad. But not your normal salad. These are cool salads.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: It's antelope day on Wild Game Kitchen and chef Andrew Zimmern is preparing two very different dishes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Every culture has their way of asking, 'What's for Dinner?' Lidia inspires shows some of her easy favourites - a flavourful arborio rice, antipasto rice salad, sauteed chicken, and mushroom gratinate.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: There is nothing like the strong seductive smell of washed rind cheeses to bring back evocative memories of a visit to France. Will travels to the misty Vosges Mountains of Alsace, the green undulating countryside of Normandy and the pretty village of Epoisse in Burgundy to look at four benchmark monastic cheeses. These are Munster, Pont L’eveque, Livarot and Epoisse. These luscious stinky cheeses have a long history but until recently were threatened with extinction and their growing popularity today is largely due to the vision and hard work of a few very passionate family owned dairies.

programme.title: Food Trail South Africa
programme.desc: To start the wine focused chapter of this Food Trail, Warren is in the Franschhoek Valley, exploring the endless bounty of Boschendal Wine Estate. After a ride on a hop-on-hop-off tram through the vineyards he dives into a tasting and cooks some decadent lamb shanks.

programme.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
programme.desc: A former medieval town, Chiavari invites visitors to slow down, wander, and connect with its people.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, this does not deter the locals from being outside for sport and food preparation.

programme.title: Kriol Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Robbie Mills: Baked Marinated Magpie Goose, Blachan, Braised Kangaroo Steaks With Asparagus Mushroom
programme.desc: In this episode, Robbie Mills shares two of his sovereign foods with us: Magpie Goose and Kangaroo.

programme.title: The Cook And The Chef
programme.desc: Cape Jervis fisherman, Alan Robertson supplies our Cook and Chef with Gummy shark and Eagle Ray, the catch you might have once thrown back, and Maggie and Simon show us why these cheaper fillets are worth a second look. Maggie then takes on a bigger challenge as she tries to convince Simon that Carp, a fish still fighting for a wider market, makes a great feed.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Laura enjoys the sunshine in the Adelaide Hills, cooking a Ricotta, Tomato and Pistachio Galette. David Mann and Charlie Carrington pimp up camp cuisine with a Thai Beef Salad cooked on the barbecue.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael kicks off summer with a fun and indulgent meal that will get everyone running to the table.

programme.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
programme.desc: Dive into a fresh selection of flavourful ingredients, starting with one of Italy's staples- prosciutto. From inventive entrees to classic pasta, the delicate taste of prosciutto infuses each dish with irresistible charm.

programme.title: Strait To The Plate
programme.desc: Aaron returns home to his old stomping ground, the Northern Peninsula Area at the tip of Cape York.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: If you're looking for something to go with a cup of tea in the afternoon, you can't go past Laura's first recipe, Florentine Cookies. Catherine Velisha assembles a Halloumi Greek Salad and jampacks it full of veggies to help you meet your daily quota.

programme.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan

programme.desc: The Alps and Savoie are covered by snow for at least 4 months of the year and cheese making here has always been a strictly seasonal affair. Will learns how the local spruce forests play an essential role in ripening the soft and unctuous Mont D’Or before heading to the high summer pastures where he visits a farm making the deliciously creamy Reblochon and learns how to grill it under hot coals. Then it’s on to visit one of the few remaining cheese makers still making Beaufort, the ‘Prince of Gruyere’ and its smaller cousin Abondance in the high alpage.

programme.desc: Switzerland has a reputation for producing the finest mountain cheeses in the world, and more than three quarters of these are still made the traditional way from raw milk. programme.desc: Newly widowed Santosh inherits her husband's job as a police constable in the rural Northern India. When a low-caste girl is murdered, Santosh is pulled into the investigation.

programme.title: The Arctic Convoy
programme.desc: As Nazi forces push deep into the Soviet Union during World War II, civilian sailors embark on a perilous Arctic mission to deliver vital supplies. Outgunned and under attack, they must rely on courage and endurance to survive one of the war's most dangerous sea crossings.

programme.title: Explorers
programme.desc: In their makeshift laboratory, three boys use an amazing discovery and their ingenuity to build their own spaceship and launch themselves on a fantastic interplanetary journey.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: Broken Hill
programme.desc: A sheep rancher's son dreams of being accepted into the Sydney Conservatorium of Music. However, he has trouble finding an adequate band in the Outback to perform his compositions, until he comes upon a talented prison choir. Directed by Dagen Merrill and stars Luke Arnold, Alexa PenaVega and Rhys Wakefield.

programme.title: Like Water For Chocolate
programme.desc: In a Mexican border town around 1910, Tita falls passionately in love with Pedro, but her controlling mother forbids her from marrying him. When Pedro marries her sister, Tita throws herself into her cooking and discovers she can transfer her emotions through the food she prepares, infecting all who eat it with her intense heartbreak. Directed by Alsonso Arau and stars Lumi Cavazos and Pedro Muzquiz.

programme.title: The Arctic Convoy
programme.desc: As Nazi forces push deep into the Soviet Union during World War II, civilian sailors embark on a perilous Arctic mission to deliver vital supplies. Outgunned and under attack, they must rely on courage and endurance to survive one of the war's most dangerous sea crossings.

programme.title: Above Us The Waves
programme.desc: Sir John Mills and Donald Sinden lead a British cast in this WWII drama, where a daring plan to destroy the German battleship Tirpitz using miniature submarines unfolds, with high stakes and intense action.

programme.title: Whisky Galore
programme.desc: During World War II, the tiny Scottish island of Todday runs out of whisky. When the freighter S.S. Cabinet Minister runs aground nearby during a heavy fog, the islanders are delighted to learn that its cargo consists of 50,000 cases of whisky. But when an officious English captain demands the return of the liquor, the islanders rebel. Stars Eddie Izzard, Gregor Fisher and Naomi Battrick.

programme.title: The Skin Of Others
programme.desc: The Skin of Others is a story of modern Australia - its violent past and its future potential - told through the extraordinary life of Aboriginal World War One soldier Douglas Grant (c.1885-1951). Featuring acclaimed Indigenous actor Balang Tom E. Lewis in his final performance (as Douglas Grant) and guest appearances from Max Cullen and Archie Roach, this film movingly interweaves the lives of Grant and Lewis: two truly remarkable men.

programme.title: The Lighthorsemen
programme.desc: Four men of the Australian Light Horse Regiment are thrust into a cavalry charge when the British campaign in Palestine becomes stalemated in 1917. In a desperate attempt, 800 young Australian horsemen set off against gunfire and insurmountable odds to save the attacking British soldiers. Stars Peter Phelps, Nick Waters and Sigrid Thorton.

programme.title: What We Do In the Shadows
programme.desc: Viago, Deacon, and Vladislav are vampires who find that modern life has them struggling with the mundane - like paying rent, keeping up with the daily chores, trying to get into nightclubs, and overcoming flatmate conflicts. Directed by and starring Jemaine Clement and Taika Waititi. Also stars Cori Gonzalez-Macuer and Karen O'Leary.

programme.desc: Parisian bon vivant, World War II Resistance fighter, Nobel Prize-winning playwright, philandering husband, and recluse... Samuel Beckett lived a life of many parts.

programme.title: Obex

Directed by Roger Donaldson and stars Kevin Costner, Bruce Greenwood and Lucinda Jenney.

programme.desc: Mathieu, a famous actor, and Alice, a piano teacher, reunite after 15 years apart at a spa, revisiting past love and confronting the passage of time and lingering emotions.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: Margaret Pomeranz and David Stratton report from Sydney and Melbourne Film Festivals with interviews including Armand Assante, Kenneth Anger, John Akomfrah and filmmakers of Black Harvest.

programme.title: The Bridge On The River Kwai
programme.desc: British POWs are ordered by their Japanese captors to construct a bridge of strategic importance and are happy to sabotage and delay the progress until their commanding officers orders them to continue the work unhindered to its completion.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: Johnny Rambo is a Vietnam vet who won many military honours. Arrested in a small town for loitering, he escapes custody and a manhunt is launched- but Rambo knows how to evade traps.

programme.title: Letters From Iwo Jima
programme.desc: As the Americans approach, the Japanese defenders dig deep into the volcanic earth of Iwo Jima. Some want to be heroes, others just want to see their wives. Directed by Clint Eastwood, starring Ken Watanabe, Kazunari Ninomiya, Tsuyoshi Ihara.

programme.desc: In the exact moment they’re hitting rock bottom, a man, two women and a boy meet a mysterious man capable of gifting them a week of time where they’ll discover how the world would be without them. Will they find the strength to start over and fall in love with life again?

programme.title: Finding Altamira
programme.desc: In 1879, a Spanish archaeologist and his eight-year-old daughter cause worldwide controversy when they discover cave paintings that are 10,000 years old. The discovery will put the family at odds with the religious and scientific leaders of the day. Directed by Hugh Hudson and stars Antonio Banderas, Clement Sibony and Golshifteh Farahani.

programme.title: The Eagle Huntress
programme.desc: This spell-binding documentary follows Aisholpan, a 13-year-old nomadic Mongolian girl who is fighting to become the first female eagle hunter in twelve generations of her Kazakh family. Through breathtaking aerial cinematography and intimate verite footage, the film captures her personal journey while also addressing universal themes like female empowerment, the natural world, coming of age and the onset of modernity.

programme.title: What We Did On Our Holiday
programme.desc: Doug and Abi take their kids on a family holiday. Surrounded by relatives, the kids innocently reveal the ins and outs of their family life and many intimate details about their parents. It's soon clear that when it comes to keeping a big secret under wraps from the rest of the family, their children are their biggest liability. Stars David Tennant and Rosamund Pike.

programme.title: U-96, The True Story Of Das Boot
programme.desc: The international success of the film Das Boot made the U-96 the most famous of all Hitler's submarines and the best-known movie submarine. But the true story of this extraordinary submarine and its equally exceptional crew goes far beyond fiction.

programme.title: The Free State Of Jones
programme.desc: After serving as a medic in the Civil War, Newton Knight returns home to Mississippi to safeguard his family. Branded as an outlaw deserter, he leads a militia of fellow deserters, runaway slaves, and women in an uprising against the corrupt local Confederate government. Directed by Gary Ross and stars Matthew McConaughey, Gugu Mbatha-Raw and Mahershala Ali.

programme.title: Flags Of Our Fathers
programme.desc: Filmmaking legends Spielberg and Eastwood collaborate on a gripping portrayal of the WWII battle for Iwo Jima, focusing on the iconic flag-raising image and the tragic loss of life on both sides.

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Bean curd, aka tofu, is the most common meat-sub for the veg-heads out there. But there's nothing common about Mary's new takes on tofu.

programme.title: Eva Pau's Asian Christmas
programme.desc: For her Festive Feast, Eva is serving up a succulent Five Spice Roast Duck with next-level. Spicy Hasselback Roast Potatoes and Eva's Chilli Garlic Sprouts will convert even the biggest sprout-avoider.

programme.title: Mary Berry Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Mary Berry's joined by famous friends who need culinary help-Mel Giedroyc, Jordan North, Anton Du Beke, Lorraine Kelly, AJ Odudu & Michael Ball-to show them how easy cooking can be.

programme.title: Batch From Scratch: Cooking For Less
programme.desc: Joe Swash and Suzanne Mulholland visit Port Talbot to help a family swap their unhealthy 'beige buffet' for fresh, home-cooked meals and reignite dad Adam's lost love for cooking.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Food Tastes Better With Sand Between Your Toes
programme.desc: In the Caribbean paradise of St. Martin, Tony eats a healthy Rastafarian meal with a freedom fighter, helps prepare grub for a food caravan, and discovers foodstuffs not available in America.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: In New Orleans, Louisiana, Tony catches a Bayou alligator, cools off with a world-famous snow cone and eats jambalaya with a dancing chef.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: Tennis player Priscilla Hon and YouTuber Ann Reardon join Adam to make the case for salad. But not your normal salad. These are cool salads.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: It's antelope day on Wild Game Kitchen and chef Andrew Zimmern is preparing two very different dishes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Every culture has their way of asking, 'What's for Dinner?' Lidia inspires shows some of her easy favourites - a flavourful arborio rice, antipasto rice salad, sauteed chicken, and mushroom gratinate.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: There is nothing like the strong seductive smell of washed rind cheeses to bring back evocative memories of a visit to France. Will travels to the misty Vosges Mountains of Alsace, the green undulating countryside of Normandy and the pretty village of Epoisse in Burgundy to look at four benchmark monastic cheeses. These are Munster, Pont L’eveque, Livarot and Epoisse. These luscious stinky cheeses have a long history but until recently were threatened with extinction and their growing popularity today is largely due to the vision and hard work of a few very passionate family owned dairies.

programme.title: Food Trail South Africa
programme.desc: To start the wine focused chapter of this Food Trail, Warren is in the Franschhoek Valley, exploring the endless bounty of Boschendal Wine Estate. After a ride on a hop-on-hop-off tram through the vineyards he dives into a tasting and cooks some decadent lamb shanks.

programme.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
programme.desc: A former medieval town, Chiavari invites visitors to slow down, wander, and connect with its people.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, this does not deter the locals from being outside for sport and food preparation.

programme.title: Kriol Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Robbie Mills: Baked Marinated Magpie Goose, Blachan, Braised Kangaroo Steaks With Asparagus Mushroom
programme.desc: In this episode, Robbie Mills shares two of his sovereign foods with us: Magpie Goose and Kangaroo.

programme.title: The Cook And The Chef
programme.desc: Cape Jervis fisherman, Alan Robertson supplies our Cook and Chef with Gummy shark and Eagle Ray, the catch you might have once thrown back, and Maggie and Simon show us why these cheaper fillets are worth a second look. Maggie then takes on a bigger challenge as she tries to convince Simon that Carp, a fish still fighting for a wider market, makes a great feed.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Laura enjoys the sunshine in the Adelaide Hills, cooking a Ricotta, Tomato and Pistachio Galette. David Mann and Charlie Carrington pimp up camp cuisine with a Thai Beef Salad cooked on the barbecue.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael kicks off summer with a fun and indulgent meal that will get everyone running to the table.

programme.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
programme.desc: Dive into a fresh selection of flavourful ingredients, starting with one of Italy's staples- prosciutto. From inventive entrees to classic pasta, the delicate taste of prosciutto infuses each dish with irresistible charm.

programme.title: Strait To The Plate
programme.desc: Aaron returns home to his old stomping ground, the Northern Peninsula Area at the tip of Cape York.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: If you're looking for something to go with a cup of tea in the afternoon, you can't go past Laura's first recipe, Florentine Cookies. Catherine Velisha assembles a Halloumi Greek Salad and jampacks it full of veggies to help you meet your daily quota.

programme.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
programme.desc: Featuring Dilruk Jayasinha, Gary prepares an ube iced latte, a rich beef rendang, Malay achar vegetable pickle, and spicy slow cooked lamb shoulder with harissa.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: Tennis player Priscilla Hon and YouTuber Ann Reardon join Adam to make the case for salad. But not your normal salad. These are cool salads.

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Mary pays tribute to desserts that stand the test of time and have a nod to nostalgia in every bite, from banoffee pie to icebox cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In Italy, it's hard to find a meal without formaggio or cheese on the table. Lidia explains the culture of milk cheeses. Recipes include: chopped salad, tomato zucchini bread lasagna, beef rolls.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: The Alps and Savoie are covered by snow for at least 4 months of the year and cheese making here has always been a strictly seasonal affair. Will learns how the local spruce forests play an essential role in ripening the soft and unctuous Mont D’Or before heading to the high summer pastures where he visits a farm making the deliciously creamy Reblochon and learns how to grill it under hot coals. Then it’s on to visit one of the few remaining cheese makers still making Beaufort, the ‘Prince of Gruyere’ and its smaller cousin Abondance in the high alpage.

programme.title: Food Trail South Africa
programme.desc: Continuing to listen to his heart, Warren deepens his love of wine by venturing to the lesser known town of Hermanus, where he'll visit Newton Johnson, the wine farm with a view.

programme.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
programme.desc: Back in the Principality, Luana spends a day dedicated to sharing, discovery, and generosity.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
programme.desc: Tareq heads out to Aland, a group of 6700 islands situated between Sweden and Finland.

programme.sub-title: Ali Mills: Magpie Goose Curry & Fried Damper
programme.desc: Performer Ali Mills prepares a yummy goose curry for us and shares some songs to while away the time as her dish cooks.

programme.title: The Cook And The Chef
programme.desc: As an oil producer Maggie has control over her favourite product from the farm to the table and you won’t be able to resist her infectious delight as she samples the first of her new season’s Oil. For Simon, oils, lots of them and lots of different types, keep his kitchens running.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Laura starts in the beautiful Adelaide Hills, where she prepares Pasta alla Norma. She joins veggie queen Catherine Velisha to celebrate the rise of the superfood kale, creating a Kale and Chickpea.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.sub-title: Chili Crisp Hot Wings And Moo Shu Pork Lettuce Cups
programme.desc: Rachael makes two takeout favorites at home, starting with chili crisp hot wings marinated overnight in Shaoxing wine and smoked soy sauce.

programme.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
programme.desc: Rich in taste yet delicate in flavour, this episode's key ingredient is extra virgin olive oil. Whether used for frying, dressing, or binding in baking, it's a true essential of Italian cuisine.

programme.title: Strait To The Plate
programme.desc: Aaron explores the island paradise of Poruma, a jewel at the heart of the Torres Strait where he explores the versatility of the coconut and learns how climate change is affecting the community.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: On a cold and windy morning in the Adelaide Hills, Laura prepares the French classic, Creme Brulee.

programme.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
programme.desc: Featuring Cath Collins, Gary makes Gwen's Curry Pasta Bake, a kachumber of green cucumber, green tomatoes, avocado, spring onion, coriander and curd.

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programme.desc: Who knew making donuts could be so easy?...and just because they're ugly, doesn't mean they're not delicious!

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: It's like staring directly at the sun - and then eating it - as host and cook Justine Schofield and chef Paul Farag join Adam to make culinary gold with the sun-shiniest of ingredients: mangoes.

programme.title: Family Dineasties
programme.desc: Kylie Kwong and Kevin La cook and dine with the family chefs from Battambang, Hai Au Lang Nuong, Temasek and Albee's Kitchen.

programme.title: Nigella Express
programme.desc: Time is of the essence when it comes to cooking the express way and it’s about the time it takes to make a meal not for it to cook. So Nigella’s conjuring up a fabulous in advance dinner of lamb, olive and caramelised onion tagine followed by a super easy, indulgent ice cream cake that can be made days ahead when you have the time, then eaten when you’re in a hurry. On the day all that’s left to do is make some cous cous to go with the tagine and a fabulous Butterscotch Sauce to pour over the cake.

programme.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
programme.desc: Sicily is the Mediterranean's largest island and is known as God's Kitchen because of its rich volcanic soil. Michelin-starred chef Tony Lo Coco shows Stanley his signature dish, spaghetti alla bottarga and elevates this humble Sicilian classic to create a salty crunchy sensation. Stanley then heads to Southern Sicily and meets artisanal winemaker Arianna Occhipinti and tries the grapes grown in the region's unique soils.

programme.desc: On the Isles of Scilly, researchers investigate whether honey bees will cross the sea to mate in a pioneering study. Elsewhere, gig racing teams compete on the water, a veteran sailor prepares for a major boat race, a teacher shares the wonders of the night sky, and the islands' footballers battle for glory in the Scillonian Cup.

programme.title: Queens That Changed The World
programme.sub-title: Ruthless Queen: Agrippina The Younger, The
programme.desc: Born into one of Rome's most powerful bloodlines, Agrippina the Younger was ambitious and ruthless, determined to secure the throne for her son Nero. Vulnerable to powerful men in her early life, she manoeuvred her way through Imperial politics, eliminating rivals and even marrying her own uncle to achieve her goal, only to be betrayed by Nero himself in devastating fashion.

programme.title: SBS World News Late
programme.desc: Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service.

programme.title: Helsinki Syndrome
programme.desc: Elias Karo and Lauri Ristiniemi's plan goes awry, forcing Elias back to the newspaper office. Hanna Raivio has found the missing page from the Karos' court documents, evidence that, if genuine, could prove a crime against the state. Editor-in-chief Susanna Simonen orders the legal department to verify it, while an entrepreneur ruined in the nineties arrives at the scene, throwing the police operation into chaos.

programme.title: Darkness: Those Who Kill
programme.desc: The search for Kim takes Louise and Frederik across the border into Sweden, as a vital clue widens the manhunt considerably. With the help of a new ally, they eventually track down Kim's remote hideout - but what they find there is far from what they were expecting, and deeply troubling.

programme.title: Santosh
programme.desc: Newly widowed Santosh inherits her husband's job as a police constable in the rural Northern India. When a low-caste girl is murdered, Santosh is pulled into the investigation.

programme.title: The Arctic Convoy
programme.desc: As Nazi forces push deep into the Soviet Union during World War II, civilian sailors embark on a perilous Arctic mission to deliver vital supplies. Outgunned and under attack, they must rely on courage and endurance to survive one of the war's most dangerous sea crossings.

programme.title: Explorers
programme.desc: In their makeshift laboratory, three boys use an amazing discovery and their ingenuity to build their own spaceship and launch themselves on a fantastic interplanetary journey.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: Broken Hill
programme.desc: A sheep rancher's son dreams of being accepted into the Sydney Conservatorium of Music. However, he has trouble finding an adequate band in the Outback to perform his compositions, until he comes upon a talented prison choir. Directed by Dagen Merrill and stars Luke Arnold, Alexa PenaVega and Rhys Wakefield.

programme.title: Like Water For Chocolate
programme.desc: In a Mexican border town around 1910, Tita falls passionately in love with Pedro, but her controlling mother forbids her from marrying him. When Pedro marries her sister, Tita throws herself into her cooking and discovers she can transfer her emotions through the food she prepares, infecting all who eat it with her intense heartbreak. Directed by Alsonso Arau and stars Lumi Cavazos and Pedro Muzquiz.

programme.title: The Arctic Convoy
programme.desc: As Nazi forces push deep into the Soviet Union during World War II, civilian sailors embark on a perilous Arctic mission to deliver vital supplies. Outgunned and under attack, they must rely on courage and endurance to survive one of the war's most dangerous sea crossings.

programme.title: Above Us The Waves
programme.desc: Sir John Mills and Donald Sinden lead a British cast in this WWII drama, where a daring plan to destroy the German battleship Tirpitz using miniature submarines unfolds, with high stakes and intense action.

programme.title: Whisky Galore
programme.desc: During World War II, the tiny Scottish island of Todday runs out of whisky. When the freighter S.S. Cabinet Minister runs aground nearby during a heavy fog, the islanders are delighted to learn that its cargo consists of 50,000 cases of whisky. But when an officious English captain demands the return of the liquor, the islanders rebel. Stars Eddie Izzard, Gregor Fisher and Naomi Battrick.

programme.title: The Skin Of Others
programme.desc: The Skin of Others is a story of modern Australia - its violent past and its future potential - told through the extraordinary life of Aboriginal World War One soldier Douglas Grant (c.1885-1951). Featuring acclaimed Indigenous actor Balang Tom E. Lewis in his final performance (as Douglas Grant) and guest appearances from Max Cullen and Archie Roach, this film movingly interweaves the lives of Grant and Lewis: two truly remarkable men.

programme.title: The Lighthorsemen
programme.desc: Four men of the Australian Light Horse Regiment are thrust into a cavalry charge when the British campaign in Palestine becomes stalemated in 1917. In a desperate attempt, 800 young Australian horsemen set off against gunfire and insurmountable odds to save the attacking British soldiers. Stars Peter Phelps, Nick Waters and Sigrid Thorton.

programme.title: What We Do In the Shadows
programme.desc: Viago, Deacon, and Vladislav are vampires who find that modern life has them struggling with the mundane - like paying rent, keeping up with the daily chores, trying to get into nightclubs, and overcoming flatmate conflicts. Directed by and starring Jemaine Clement and Taika Waititi. Also stars Cori Gonzalez-Macuer and Karen O'Leary.

programme.title: Dance First
programme.desc: Parisian bon vivant, World War II Resistance fighter, Nobel Prize-winning playwright, philandering husband, and recluse... Samuel Beckett lived a life of many parts.

programme.title: Obex
programme.desc: Conor Marsh lives a secluded life with his dog, Sandy, until one day he begins playing OBEX, a new, state-of-the-art computer game. When Sandy disappears, the line between reality and gaming blurs, and Conor must enter the world of OBEX to save her.

programme.title: Ka Whawhai Tonu

programme.desc: In October 1962, President John F. Kennedy learns about the Soviet Union's plan of placing nuclear weapons in Cuba. These weapons could wipe out most of the eastern and southern United States in minutes if they become operational. Kennedy and his advisors must come up with a plan of action against the Soviets. Directed by Roger Donaldson and stars Kevin Costner, Bruce Greenwood and Lucinda Jenney.

programme.title: Ka Whawhai Tonu

programme.title: Out Of Season
programme.desc: Mathieu, a famous actor, and Alice, a piano teacher, reunite after 15 years apart at a spa, revisiting past love and confronting the passage of time and lingering emotions.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: Margaret Pomeranz and David Stratton report from Sydney and Melbourne Film Festivals with interviews including Armand Assante, Kenneth Anger, John Akomfrah and filmmakers of Black Harvest.

programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: The Bridge On The River Kwai
programme.desc: British POWs are ordered by their Japanese captors to construct a bridge of strategic importance and are happy to sabotage and delay the progress until their commanding officers orders them to continue the work unhindered to its completion.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: Johnny Rambo is a Vietnam vet who won many military honours. Arrested in a small town for loitering, he escapes custody and a manhunt is launched- but Rambo knows how to evade traps.

programme.title: Letters From Iwo Jima
programme.desc: As the Americans approach, the Japanese defenders dig deep into the volcanic earth of Iwo Jima. Some want to be heroes, others just want to see their wives. Directed by Clint Eastwood, starring Ken Watanabe, Kazunari Ninomiya, Tsuyoshi Ihara.

programme.title: Letters From Iwo Jima
programme.desc: As the Americans approach, the Japanese defenders dig deep into the volcanic earth of Iwo Jima. Some want to be heroes, others just want to see their wives. Directed by Clint Eastwood, starring Ken Watanabe, Kazunari Ninomiya, Tsuyoshi Ihara.

programme.title: The First Day Of My Life
programme.desc: In the exact moment they’re hitting rock bottom, a man, two women and a boy meet a mysterious man capable of gifting them a week of time where they’ll discover how the world would be without them. Will they find the strength to start over and fall in love with life again?

programme.title: Finding Altamira
programme.desc: In 1879, a Spanish archaeologist and his eight-year-old daughter cause worldwide controversy when they discover cave paintings that are 10,000 years old. The discovery will put the family at odds with the religious and scientific leaders of the day. Directed by Hugh Hudson and stars Antonio Banderas, Clement Sibony and Golshifteh Farahani.

programme.title: The Eagle Huntress
programme.desc: This spell-binding documentary follows Aisholpan, a 13-year-old nomadic Mongolian girl who is fighting to become the first female eagle hunter in twelve generations of her Kazakh family. Through breathtaking aerial cinematography and intimate verite footage, the film captures her personal journey while also addressing universal themes like female empowerment, the natural world, coming of age and the onset of modernity.

programme.title: What We Did On Our Holiday
programme.desc: Doug and Abi take their kids on a family holiday. Surrounded by relatives, the kids innocently reveal the ins and outs of their family life and many intimate details about their parents. It's soon clear that when it comes to keeping a big secret under wraps from the rest of the family, their children are their biggest liability. Stars David Tennant and Rosamund Pike.

programme.title: U-96, The True Story Of Das Boot
programme.desc: The international success of the film Das Boot made the U-96 the most famous of all Hitler's submarines and the best-known movie submarine. But the true story of this extraordinary submarine and its equally exceptional crew goes far beyond fiction.

programme.title: The Free State Of Jones
programme.desc: After serving as a medic in the Civil War, Newton Knight returns home to Mississippi to safeguard his family. Branded as an outlaw deserter, he leads a militia of fellow deserters, runaway slaves, and women in an uprising against the corrupt local Confederate government. Directed by Gary Ross and stars Matthew McConaughey, Gugu Mbatha-Raw and Mahershala Ali.

programme.title: Flags Of Our Fathers
programme.desc: Filmmaking legends Spielberg and Eastwood collaborate on a gripping portrayal of the WWII battle for Iwo Jima, focusing on the iconic flag-raising image and the tragic loss of life on both sides.

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Bean curd, aka tofu, is the most common meat-sub for the veg-heads out there. But there's nothing common about Mary's new takes on tofu.

programme.title: Eva Pau's Asian Christmas
programme.desc: For her Festive Feast, Eva is serving up a succulent Five Spice Roast Duck with next-level. Spicy Hasselback Roast Potatoes and Eva's Chilli Garlic Sprouts will convert even the biggest sprout-avoider.

programme.title: Mary Berry Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Mary Berry's joined by famous friends who need culinary help-Mel Giedroyc, Jordan North, Anton Du Beke, Lorraine Kelly, AJ Odudu & Michael Ball-to show them how easy cooking can be.

programme.title: Batch From Scratch: Cooking For Less
programme.desc: Joe Swash and Suzanne Mulholland visit Port Talbot to help a family swap their unhealthy 'beige buffet' for fresh, home-cooked meals and reignite dad Adam's lost love for cooking.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Food Tastes Better With Sand Between Your Toes
programme.desc: In the Caribbean paradise of St. Martin, Tony eats a healthy Rastafarian meal with a freedom fighter, helps prepare grub for a food caravan, and discovers foodstuffs not available in America.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: In New Orleans, Louisiana, Tony catches a Bayou alligator, cools off with a world-famous snow cone and eats jambalaya with a dancing chef.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: Tennis player Priscilla Hon and YouTuber Ann Reardon join Adam to make the case for salad. But not your normal salad. These are cool salads.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: It's antelope day on Wild Game Kitchen and chef Andrew Zimmern is preparing two very different dishes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Every culture has their way of asking, 'What's for Dinner?' Lidia inspires shows some of her easy favourites - a flavourful arborio rice, antipasto rice salad, sauteed chicken, and mushroom gratinate.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: There is nothing like the strong seductive smell of washed rind cheeses to bring back evocative memories of a visit to France. Will travels to the misty Vosges Mountains of Alsace, the green undulating countryside of Normandy and the pretty village of Epoisse in Burgundy to look at four benchmark monastic cheeses. These are Munster, Pont L’eveque, Livarot and Epoisse. These luscious stinky cheeses have a long history but until recently were threatened with extinction and their growing popularity today is largely due to the vision and hard work of a few very passionate family owned dairies.

programme.title: Food Trail South Africa
programme.desc: To start the wine focused chapter of this Food Trail, Warren is in the Franschhoek Valley, exploring the endless bounty of Boschendal Wine Estate. After a ride on a hop-on-hop-off tram through the vineyards he dives into a tasting and cooks some decadent lamb shanks.

programme.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
programme.desc: A former medieval town, Chiavari invites visitors to slow down, wander, and connect with its people.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, this does not deter the locals from being outside for sport and food preparation.

programme.title: Kriol Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Robbie Mills: Baked Marinated Magpie Goose, Blachan, Braised Kangaroo Steaks With Asparagus Mushroom
programme.desc: In this episode, Robbie Mills shares two of his sovereign foods with us: Magpie Goose and Kangaroo.

programme.title: The Cook And The Chef
programme.desc: Cape Jervis fisherman, Alan Robertson supplies our Cook and Chef with Gummy shark and Eagle Ray, the catch you might have once thrown back, and Maggie and Simon show us why these cheaper fillets are worth a second look. Maggie then takes on a bigger challenge as she tries to convince Simon that Carp, a fish still fighting for a wider market, makes a great feed.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Laura enjoys the sunshine in the Adelaide Hills, cooking a Ricotta, Tomato and Pistachio Galette. David Mann and Charlie Carrington pimp up camp cuisine with a Thai Beef Salad cooked on the barbecue.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael kicks off summer with a fun and indulgent meal that will get everyone running to the table.

programme.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
programme.desc: Dive into a fresh selection of flavourful ingredients, starting with one of Italy's staples- prosciutto. From inventive entrees to classic pasta, the delicate taste of prosciutto infuses each dish with irresistible charm.

programme.title: Strait To The Plate
programme.desc: Aaron returns home to his old stomping ground, the Northern Peninsula Area at the tip of Cape York.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: If you're looking for something to go with a cup of tea in the afternoon, you can't go past Laura's first recipe, Florentine Cookies. Catherine Velisha assembles a Halloumi Greek Salad and jampacks it full of veggies to help you meet your daily quota.

programme.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
programme.desc: Featuring Dilruk Jayasinha, Gary prepares an ube iced latte, a rich beef rendang, Malay achar vegetable pickle, and spicy slow cooked lamb shoulder with harissa.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: Tennis player Priscilla Hon and YouTuber Ann Reardon join Adam to make the case for salad. But not your normal salad. These are cool salads.

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Mary pays tribute to desserts that stand the test of time and have a nod to nostalgia in every bite, from banoffee pie to icebox cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In Italy, it's hard to find a meal without formaggio or cheese on the table. Lidia explains the culture of milk cheeses. Recipes include: chopped salad, tomato zucchini bread lasagna, beef rolls.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: The Alps and Savoie are covered by snow for at least 4 months of the year and cheese making here has always been a strictly seasonal affair. Will learns how the local spruce forests play an essential role in ripening the soft and unctuous Mont D’Or before heading to the high summer pastures where he visits a farm making the deliciously creamy Reblochon and learns how to grill it under hot coals. Then it’s on to visit one of the few remaining cheese makers still making Beaufort, the ‘Prince of Gruyere’ and its smaller cousin Abondance in the high alpage.

programme.title: Food Trail South Africa
programme.desc: Continuing to listen to his heart, Warren deepens his love of wine by venturing to the lesser known town of Hermanus, where he'll visit Newton Johnson, the wine farm with a view.

programme.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
programme.desc: Back in the Principality, Luana spends a day dedicated to sharing, discovery, and generosity.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
programme.desc: Tareq heads out to Aland, a group of 6700 islands situated between Sweden and Finland.

programme.title: Kriol Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Ali Mills: Magpie Goose Curry & Fried Damper
programme.desc: Performer Ali Mills prepares a yummy goose curry for us and shares some songs to while away the time as her dish cooks.

programme.title: The Cook And The Chef
programme.desc: As an oil producer Maggie has control over her favourite product from the farm to the table and you won’t be able to resist her infectious delight as she samples the first of her new season’s Oil. For Simon, oils, lots of them and lots of different types, keep his kitchens running.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Laura starts in the beautiful Adelaide Hills, where she prepares Pasta alla Norma. She joins veggie queen Catherine Velisha to celebrate the rise of the superfood kale, creating a Kale and Chickpea.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.sub-title: Chili Crisp Hot Wings And Moo Shu Pork Lettuce Cups
programme.desc: Rachael makes two takeout favorites at home, starting with chili crisp hot wings marinated overnight in Shaoxing wine and smoked soy sauce.

programme.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
programme.desc: Rich in taste yet delicate in flavour, this episode's key ingredient is extra virgin olive oil. Whether used for frying, dressing, or binding in baking, it's a true essential of Italian cuisine.

programme.title: Strait To The Plate
programme.desc: Aaron explores the island paradise of Poruma, a jewel at the heart of the Torres Strait where he explores the versatility of the coconut and learns how climate change is affecting the community.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: On a cold and windy morning in the Adelaide Hills, Laura prepares the French classic, Creme Brulee.

programme.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
programme.desc: Featuring Cath Collins, Gary makes Gwen's Curry Pasta Bake, a kachumber of green cucumber, green tomatoes, avocado, spring onion, coriander and curd.

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programme.desc: Who knew making donuts could be so easy?...and just because they're ugly, doesn't mean they're not delicious!

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: It's like staring directly at the sun - and then eating it - as host and cook Justine Schofield and chef Paul Farag join Adam to make culinary gold with the sun-shiniest of ingredients: mangoes.

programme.title: Family Dineasties
programme.desc: Kylie Kwong and Kevin La cook and dine with the family chefs from Battambang, Hai Au Lang Nuong, Temasek and Albee's Kitchen.

programme.title: Nigella Express
programme.desc: Time is of the essence when it comes to cooking the express way and it’s about the time it takes to make a meal not for it to cook. So Nigella’s conjuring up a fabulous in advance dinner of lamb, olive and caramelised onion tagine followed by a super easy, indulgent ice cream cake that can be made days ahead when you have the time, then eaten when you’re in a hurry. On the day all that’s left to do is make some cous cous to go with the tagine and a fabulous Butterscotch Sauce to pour over the cake.

programme.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
programme.desc: Sicily is the Mediterranean's largest island and is known as God's Kitchen because of its rich volcanic soil. Michelin-starred chef Tony Lo Coco shows Stanley his signature dish, spaghetti alla bottarga and elevates this humble Sicilian classic to create a salty crunchy sensation. Stanley then heads to Southern Sicily and meets artisanal winemaker Arianna Occhipinti and tries the grapes grown in the region's unique soils.

Later, a surprise visitor to the clinic leaves Dr Chris genuinely speechless.

programme.title: Scottish Vets Down Under
programme.desc: At the animal hospital, Dr Chris tends to a pair of fascinating reptiles and checks in on some recovering wildlife patients. It's one of the most demanding procedures an equine vet can face, and despite everyone's best efforts, the day takes a devastating turn.

These are Munster, Pont L’eveque, Livarot and Epoisse. These luscious stinky cheeses have a long history but until recently were threatened with extinction and their growing popularity today is largely due to the vision and hard work of a few very passionate family owned dairies.

Editor-in-chief Susanna Simonen orders the legal department to verify it, while an entrepreneur ruined in the nineties arrives at the scene, throwing the police operation into chaos.

programme.title: Darkness: Those Who Kill
programme.desc: The search for Kim takes Louise and Frederik across the border into Sweden, as a vital clue widens the manhunt considerably. With the help of a new ally, they eventually track down Kim's remote hideout - but what they find there is far from what they were expecting, and deeply troubling.

programme.title: Santosh
programme.desc: Newly widowed Santosh inherits her husband's job as a police constable in the rural Northern India. When a low-caste girl is murdered, Santosh is pulled into the investigation.

programme.title: The Arctic Convoy
programme.desc: As Nazi forces push deep into the Soviet Union during World War II, civilian sailors embark on a perilous Arctic mission to deliver vital supplies. Outgunned and under attack, they must rely on courage and endurance to survive one of the war's most dangerous sea crossings.

programme.title: Explorers
programme.desc: In their makeshift laboratory, three boys use an amazing discovery and their ingenuity to build their own spaceship and launch themselves on a fantastic interplanetary journey.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: Broken Hill
programme.desc: A sheep rancher's son dreams of being accepted into the Sydney Conservatorium of Music. However, he has trouble finding an adequate band in the Outback to perform his compositions, until he comes upon a talented prison choir. Directed by Dagen Merrill and stars Luke Arnold, Alexa PenaVega and Rhys Wakefield.

programme.title: Like Water For Chocolate
programme.desc: In a Mexican border town around 1910, Tita falls passionately in love with Pedro, but her controlling mother forbids her from marrying him. When Pedro marries her sister, Tita throws herself into her cooking and discovers she can transfer her emotions through the food she prepares, infecting all who eat it with her intense heartbreak. Directed by Alsonso Arau and stars Lumi Cavazos and Pedro Muzquiz.

programme.title: The Arctic Convoy
programme.desc: As Nazi forces push deep into the Soviet Union during World War II, civilian sailors embark on a perilous Arctic mission to deliver vital supplies. Outgunned and under attack, they must rely on courage and endurance to survive one of the war's most dangerous sea crossings.

programme.title: Above Us The Waves
programme.desc: Sir John Mills and Donald Sinden lead a British cast in this WWII drama, where a daring plan to destroy the German battleship Tirpitz using miniature submarines unfolds, with high stakes and intense action.

programme.title: Whisky Galore
programme.desc: During World War II, the tiny Scottish island of Todday runs out of whisky. When the freighter S.S. Cabinet Minister runs aground nearby during a heavy fog, the islanders are delighted to learn that its cargo consists of 50,000 cases of whisky. But when an officious English captain demands the return of the liquor, the islanders rebel. Stars Eddie Izzard, Gregor Fisher and Naomi Battrick.

programme.title: The Skin Of Others
programme.desc: The Skin of Others is a story of modern Australia - its violent past and its future potential - told through the extraordinary life of Aboriginal World War One soldier Douglas Grant (c.1885-1951). Featuring acclaimed Indigenous actor Balang Tom E. Lewis in his final performance (as Douglas Grant) and guest appearances from Max Cullen and Archie Roach, this film movingly interweaves the lives of Grant and Lewis: two truly remarkable men.

programme.title: The Lighthorsemen
programme.desc: Four men of the Australian Light Horse Regiment are thrust into a cavalry charge when the British campaign in Palestine becomes stalemated in 1917. In a desperate attempt, 800 young Australian horsemen set off against gunfire and insurmountable odds to save the attacking British soldiers. Stars Peter Phelps, Nick Waters and Sigrid Thorton.

programme.title: What We Do In the Shadows
programme.desc: Viago, Deacon, and Vladislav are vampires who find that modern life has them struggling with the mundane - like paying rent, keeping up with the daily chores, trying to get into nightclubs, and overcoming flatmate conflicts. Directed by and starring Jemaine Clement and Taika Waititi. Also stars Cori Gonzalez-Macuer and Karen O'Leary.

programme.title: Dance First
programme.desc: Parisian bon vivant, World War II Resistance fighter, Nobel Prize-winning playwright, philandering husband, and recluse... Samuel Beckett lived a life of many parts.

programme.title: Obex
programme.desc: Conor Marsh lives a secluded life with his dog, Sandy, until one day he begins playing OBEX, a new, state-of-the-art computer game. When Sandy disappears, the line between reality and gaming blurs, and Conor must enter the world of OBEX to save her.

programme.title: Ka Whawhai Tonu

programme.desc: In October 1962, President John F. Kennedy learns about the Soviet Union's plan of placing nuclear weapons in Cuba. These weapons could wipe out most of the eastern and southern United States in minutes if they become operational. Kennedy and his advisors must come up with a plan of action against the Soviets. Directed by Roger Donaldson and stars Kevin Costner, Bruce Greenwood and Lucinda Jenney.

programme.title: Ka Whawhai Tonu
programme.desc: A half-caste boy-soldier and a Maori girl-prophet strike up an unlikely friendship in the midst of the climactic battle of the New Zealand.

programme.title: Out Of Season
programme.desc: Mathieu, a famous actor, and Alice, a piano teacher, reunite after 15 years apart at a spa, revisiting past love and confronting the passage of time and lingering emotions.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: Margaret Pomeranz and David Stratton report from Sydney and Melbourne Film Festivals with interviews including Armand Assante, Kenneth Anger, John Akomfrah and filmmakers of Black Harvest.

programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: The Bridge On The River Kwai
programme.desc: British POWs are ordered by their Japanese captors to construct a bridge of strategic importance and are happy to sabotage and delay the progress until their commanding officers orders them to continue the work unhindered to its completion.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: Johnny Rambo is a Vietnam vet who won many military honours. Arrested in a small town for loitering, he escapes custody and a manhunt is launched- but Rambo knows how to evade traps.

programme.title: Letters From Iwo Jima
programme.desc: As the Americans approach, the Japanese defenders dig deep into the volcanic earth of Iwo Jima. Some want to be heroes, others just want to see their wives. Directed by Clint Eastwood, starring Ken Watanabe, Kazunari Ninomiya, Tsuyoshi Ihara.

programme.title: Letters From Iwo Jima
programme.desc: As the Americans approach, the Japanese defenders dig deep into the volcanic earth of Iwo Jima. Some want to be heroes, others just want to see their wives. Directed by Clint Eastwood, starring Ken Watanabe, Kazunari Ninomiya, Tsuyoshi Ihara.

programme.title: The First Day Of My Life
programme.desc: In the exact moment they’re hitting rock bottom, a man, two women and a boy meet a mysterious man capable of gifting them a week of time where they’ll discover how the world would be without them. Will they find the strength to start over and fall in love with life again?

programme.title: Finding Altamira
programme.desc: In 1879, a Spanish archaeologist and his eight-year-old daughter cause worldwide controversy when they discover cave paintings that are 10,000 years old. The discovery will put the family at odds with the religious and scientific leaders of the day. Directed by Hugh Hudson and stars Antonio Banderas, Clement Sibony and Golshifteh Farahani.

programme.title: The Eagle Huntress
programme.desc: This spell-binding documentary follows Aisholpan, a 13-year-old nomadic Mongolian girl who is fighting to become the first female eagle hunter in twelve generations of her Kazakh family. Through breathtaking aerial cinematography and intimate verite footage, the film captures her personal journey while also addressing universal themes like female empowerment, the natural world, coming of age and the onset of modernity.

programme.title: What We Did On Our Holiday
programme.desc: Doug and Abi take their kids on a family holiday. Surrounded by relatives, the kids innocently reveal the ins and outs of their family life and many intimate details about their parents. It's soon clear that when it comes to keeping a big secret under wraps from the rest of the family, their children are their biggest liability. Stars David Tennant and Rosamund Pike.

programme.title: U-96, The True Story Of Das Boot
programme.desc: The international success of the film Das Boot made the U-96 the most famous of all Hitler's submarines and the best-known movie submarine. But the true story of this extraordinary submarine and its equally exceptional crew goes far beyond fiction.

programme.title: The Free State Of Jones
programme.desc: After serving as a medic in the Civil War, Newton Knight returns home to Mississippi to safeguard his family. Branded as an outlaw deserter, he leads a militia of fellow deserters, runaway slaves, and women in an uprising against the corrupt local Confederate government. Directed by Gary Ross and stars Matthew McConaughey, Gugu Mbatha-Raw and Mahershala Ali.

programme.title: Flags Of Our Fathers
programme.desc: Filmmaking legends Spielberg and Eastwood collaborate on a gripping portrayal of the WWII battle for Iwo Jima, focusing on the iconic flag-raising image and the tragic loss of life on both sides.

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Bean curd, aka tofu, is the most common meat-sub for the veg-heads out there. But there's nothing common about Mary's new takes on tofu.

programme.title: Eva Pau's Asian Christmas
programme.desc: For her Festive Feast, Eva is serving up a succulent Five Spice Roast Duck with next-level. Spicy Hasselback Roast Potatoes and Eva's Chilli Garlic Sprouts will convert even the biggest sprout-avoider.

programme.title: Mary Berry Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Mary Berry's joined by famous friends who need culinary help-Mel Giedroyc, Jordan North, Anton Du Beke, Lorraine Kelly, AJ Odudu & Michael Ball-to show them how easy cooking can be.

programme.title: Batch From Scratch: Cooking For Less
programme.desc: Joe Swash and Suzanne Mulholland visit Port Talbot to help a family swap their unhealthy 'beige buffet' for fresh, home-cooked meals and reignite dad Adam's lost love for cooking.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Food Tastes Better With Sand Between Your Toes
programme.desc: In the Caribbean paradise of St. Martin, Tony eats a healthy Rastafarian meal with a freedom fighter, helps prepare grub for a food caravan, and discovers foodstuffs not available in America.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: In New Orleans, Louisiana, Tony catches a Bayou alligator, cools off with a world-famous snow cone and eats jambalaya with a dancing chef.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: Tennis player Priscilla Hon and YouTuber Ann Reardon join Adam to make the case for salad. But not your normal salad. These are cool salads.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: It's antelope day on Wild Game Kitchen and chef Andrew Zimmern is preparing two very different dishes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Every culture has their way of asking, 'What's for Dinner?' Lidia inspires shows some of her easy favourites - a flavourful arborio rice, antipasto rice salad, sauteed chicken, and mushroom gratinate.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: There is nothing like the strong seductive smell of washed rind cheeses to bring back evocative memories of a visit to France. Will travels to the misty Vosges Mountains of Alsace, the green undulating countryside of Normandy and the pretty village of Epoisse in Burgundy to look at four benchmark monastic cheeses. These are Munster, Pont L’eveque, Livarot and Epoisse. These luscious stinky cheeses have a long history but until recently were threatened with extinction and their growing popularity today is largely due to the vision and hard work of a few very passionate family owned dairies.

programme.title: Food Trail South Africa
programme.desc: To start the wine focused chapter of this Food Trail, Warren is in the Franschhoek Valley, exploring the endless bounty of Boschendal Wine Estate. After a ride on a hop-on-hop-off tram through the vineyards he dives into a tasting and cooks some decadent lamb shanks.

programme.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
programme.desc: A former medieval town, Chiavari invites visitors to slow down, wander, and connect with its people.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, this does not deter the locals from being outside for sport and food preparation.

programme.title: Kriol Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Robbie Mills: Baked Marinated Magpie Goose, Blachan, Braised Kangaroo Steaks With Asparagus Mushroom
programme.desc: In this episode, Robbie Mills shares two of his sovereign foods with us: Magpie Goose and Kangaroo.

programme.title: The Cook And The Chef
programme.desc: Cape Jervis fisherman, Alan Robertson supplies our Cook and Chef with Gummy shark and Eagle Ray, the catch you might have once thrown back, and Maggie and Simon show us why these cheaper fillets are worth a second look. Maggie then takes on a bigger challenge as she tries to convince Simon that Carp, a fish still fighting for a wider market, makes a great feed.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Laura enjoys the sunshine in the Adelaide Hills, cooking a Ricotta, Tomato and Pistachio Galette. David Mann and Charlie Carrington pimp up camp cuisine with a Thai Beef Salad cooked on the barbecue.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael kicks off summer with a fun and indulgent meal that will get everyone running to the table.

programme.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
programme.desc: Dive into a fresh selection of flavourful ingredients, starting with one of Italy's staples- prosciutto. From inventive entrees to classic pasta, the delicate taste of prosciutto infuses each dish with irresistible charm.

programme.title: Strait To The Plate
programme.desc: Aaron returns home to his old stomping ground, the Northern Peninsula Area at the tip of Cape York.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: If you're looking for something to go with a cup of tea in the afternoon, you can't go past Laura's first recipe, Florentine Cookies. Catherine Velisha assembles a Halloumi Greek Salad and jampacks it full of veggies to help you meet your daily quota.

programme.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
programme.desc: Featuring Dilruk Jayasinha, Gary prepares an ube iced latte, a rich beef rendang, Malay achar vegetable pickle, and spicy slow cooked lamb shoulder with harissa.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: Tennis player Priscilla Hon and YouTuber Ann Reardon join Adam to make the case for salad. But not your normal salad. These are cool salads.

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Mary pays tribute to desserts that stand the test of time and have a nod to nostalgia in every bite, from banoffee pie to icebox cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In Italy, it's hard to find a meal without formaggio or cheese on the table. Lidia explains the culture of milk cheeses. Recipes include: chopped salad, tomato zucchini bread lasagna, beef rolls.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: The Alps and Savoie are covered by snow for at least 4 months of the year and cheese making here has always been a strictly seasonal affair. Will learns how the local spruce forests play an essential role in ripening the soft and unctuous Mont D’Or before heading to the high summer pastures where he visits a farm making the deliciously creamy Reblochon and learns how to grill it under hot coals. Then it’s on to visit one of the few remaining cheese makers still making Beaufort, the ‘Prince of Gruyere’ and its smaller cousin Abondance in the high alpage.

programme.title: Food Trail South Africa
programme.desc: Continuing to listen to his heart, Warren deepens his love of wine by venturing to the lesser known town of Hermanus, where he'll visit Newton Johnson, the wine farm with a view.

programme.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
programme.desc: Back in the Principality, Luana spends a day dedicated to sharing, discovery, and generosity.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
programme.desc: Tareq heads out to Aland, a group of 6700 islands situated between Sweden and Finland.

programme.title: Kriol Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Ali Mills: Magpie Goose Curry & Fried Damper
programme.desc: Performer Ali Mills prepares a yummy goose curry for us and shares some songs to while away the time as her dish cooks.

programme.title: The Cook And The Chef
programme.desc: As an oil producer Maggie has control over her favourite product from the farm to the table and you won’t be able to resist her infectious delight as she samples the first of her new season’s Oil. For Simon, oils, lots of them and lots of different types, keep his kitchens running.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Laura starts in the beautiful Adelaide Hills, where she prepares Pasta alla Norma. She joins veggie queen Catherine Velisha to celebrate the rise of the superfood kale, creating a Kale and Chickpea.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.sub-title: Chili Crisp Hot Wings And Moo Shu Pork Lettuce Cups
programme.desc: Rachael makes two takeout favorites at home, starting with chili crisp hot wings marinated overnight in Shaoxing wine and smoked soy sauce.

programme.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
programme.desc: Rich in taste yet delicate in flavour, this episode's key ingredient is extra virgin olive oil. Whether used for frying, dressing, or binding in baking, it's a true essential of Italian cuisine.

programme.title: Strait To The Plate
programme.desc: Aaron explores the island paradise of Poruma, a jewel at the heart of the Torres Strait where he explores the versatility of the coconut and learns how climate change is affecting the community.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: On a cold and windy morning in the Adelaide Hills, Laura prepares the French classic, Creme Brulee.

programme.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
programme.desc: Featuring Cath Collins, Gary makes Gwen's Curry Pasta Bake, a kachumber of green cucumber, green tomatoes, avocado, spring onion, coriander and curd.

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programme.desc: Who knew making donuts could be so easy?...and just because they're ugly, doesn't mean they're not delicious!

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: It's like staring directly at the sun - and then eating it - as host and cook Justine Schofield and chef Paul Farag join Adam to make culinary gold with the sun-shiniest of ingredients: mangoes.

programme.title: Family Dineasties
programme.desc: Kylie Kwong and Kevin La cook and dine with the family chefs from Battambang, Hai Au Lang Nuong, Temasek and Albee's Kitchen.

programme.title: Nigella Express
programme.desc: Time is of the essence when it comes to cooking the express way and it’s about the time it takes to make a meal not for it to cook. So Nigella’s conjuring up a fabulous in advance dinner of lamb, olive and caramelised onion tagine followed by a super easy, indulgent ice cream cake that can be made days ahead when you have the time, then eaten when you’re in a hurry. On the day all that’s left to do is make some cous cous to go with the tagine and a fabulous Butterscotch Sauce to pour over the cake.

programme.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
programme.desc: Sicily is the Mediterranean's largest island and is known as God's Kitchen because of its rich volcanic soil. Michelin-starred chef Tony Lo Coco shows Stanley his signature dish, spaghetti alla bottarga and elevates this humble Sicilian classic to create a salty crunchy sensation. Stanley then heads to Southern Sicily and meets artisanal winemaker Arianna Occhipinti and tries the grapes grown in the region's unique soils.
